snip: You have asked me, more than once and in your patient way, to set the true thing down. I have put yo
quote: You have asked me, more than once and in your patient way, to set the true thing down. I have put you off with the skill of long practice. But the wanting to has come over me lately, quiet and from behind, the way most of my best and worst ideas have arrived. And when I turn my mind to how it would have to go, I find I know at least where it would not begin. Not on a wonder, and not on a boy. There is no boy in it, whatever the tellers would prefer, and no wonder either, not at the start of it. I think I would begin with the man himself, such as he was in those days: at the tired end of a bad few years, with far more skill than he had sense and nowhere in all the wide world that he needed to be. And I think, before I let him take a single step, I would ask you to go easy on him.

snip: My first attempt at the working itself was a failure, and an instructive one, and I mention it becau
quote: My first attempt at the working itself was a failure, and an instructive one, and I mention it because a story would have you believe such things come to a man whole and shining, and they do not. I built the first version to draw. To reach frankly into the hill’s song and pull up a good draught of it and make a bright light, a proper light, a light to be proud of. And the hill did to that lamp precisely what it had done to me the morning I went up the crown wanting to take something: nothing at all. The glass stayed dark. The working sat in it sound and elegant and greedy, and the hill declined to be at home to it, and I sat in the dark I had failed to lift and laughed, because I had known better and done the greedy thing anyway, which is the oldest failing in my trade and mine more than most men’s. I unpicked it and built it smaller and asked for less and left the hill more room to give what it chose, and that was the version that woke. A lamp that asks a little of a thing is given it. A lamp that demands a great deal gets a dark room and a lesson. I have come to think there is no working I have ever done on that hill that was not, underneath, the same working in different clothes, done over and over: the one called asking.
